```{r}
legal_drugs <- c("Caffeine_Use", "Nicotine_Use", "Alcohol_Use", "Chocolate_Use")
illegal_drugs <- c("Cocaine_Use", "Ketamine_Use", "Heroin_Use", "LSD_Use")

# Gather legal and illegal drugs together with a flag
ddata_long <- ddata %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(c(legal_drugs, illegal_drugs)),
               names_to = "Drug",
               values_to = "Usage") %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Drug %in% legal_drugs, "Legal", "Illegal"))
ddata_long
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# Function to plot personality trait by ussage and separate by Legal/Illegal category
plot_personality_trait <- function(data, trait, fill_colors = c("#BCB8F0", "#E9006D")) {
  ggplot(data, aes_string(x = "Usage", y = trait, fill = "Usage")) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    facet_wrap(~Category) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = paste(trait, "Score"),
      fill = "Usage"
    ) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    theme_classic()
}

# Create the plots
neuro_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Neuroticism")
extraversion_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Extraversion")
openness_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Openness")
agreeableness_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Agreeableness")
consc_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Conscientiousness")
impulsivity_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Impulsivity")
SS_boxplot <- plot_personality_trait(ddata_long, "Sensation_Seeking")


# Arrange the plots in a 2x2 grid
combined_plot <- ggarrange(neuro_boxplot, extraversion_boxplot, openness_boxplot, agreeableness_boxplot,
                           ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
combined_plot2 <- ggarrange(consc_boxplot, impulsivity_boxplot, SS_boxplot,
          ncol = 2, nrow = 2)


# Add one common title above all plots
annotate_figure(combined_plot, 
                top = text_grob("Personality Traits by Drug Use for Legal and Illegal Drugs",
                                face = "bold", size = 14))

annotate_figure(combined_plot2, 
                top = text_grob("Personality Traits by Drug Use for Legal and Illegal Drugs",
                                face = "bold", size = 14))
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

#data
ddata <- read_excel(
  "CLEANING DATA DRUG.xlsx",
  sheet = "DATA_FINAL_ANALYSIS"
)

# age + ed
ddata$AgeEdu <- paste(ddata$Age_Group, ddata$Education_Level_Final, sep = " / ")

# drugs
keep_drugs <- c(
  "Caffeine_Use",
  "Nicotine_Use",
  "Alcohol_Use",
  "Chocolate_Use",
  "Cocaine_Use",
  "Ketamine_Use",
  "Heroin_Use",
  "LSD_Use"
)

d_long <- ddata %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(keep_drugs),
    names_to  = "Drug",
    values_to = "Use"
  ) %>%
  filter(Use == "User")

#clean labels 
pretty_drug_labels <- function(mat) {
  labs <- colnames(mat)
  labs <- gsub("_Use$", "", labs)
  labs <- gsub("_", " ", labs)
  labs
}

# color
overall_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#b38bff"))(50)   
male_colors    <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#6bb6ff"))(50)  
female_colors  <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#ff8ac6"))(50)   


# overall heatmap
all_tab <- d_long %>%
  count(AgeEdu, Drug, name = "Users") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Drug,
    values_from = Users,
    values_fill = 0
  )

mat_all <- as.matrix(all_tab[, -1])
rownames(mat_all) <- all_tab$AgeEdu

pheatmap(
  mat_all,
  main = "Drug Use by Age + Education (All)",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  labels_col = pretty_drug_labels(mat_all),
  color = overall_colors
)

#male heatmap 
male_tab <- d_long %>%
  filter(Gender == "Male") %>%
  count(AgeEdu, Drug, name = "Users") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Drug,
    values_from = Users,
    values_fill = 0
  )

mat_male <- as.matrix(male_tab[, -1])
rownames(mat_male) <- male_tab$AgeEdu

pheatmap(
  mat_male,
  main = "Drug Use by Age + Education (Male)",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  labels_col = pretty_drug_labels(mat_male),
  color = male_colors
)

# female heatmap
female_tab <- d_long %>%
  filter(Gender == "Female") %>%
  count(AgeEdu, Drug, name = "Users") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Drug,
    values_from = Users,
    values_fill = 0
  )

mat_female <- as.matrix(female_tab[, -1])
rownames(mat_female) <- female_tab$AgeEdu

pheatmap(
  mat_female,
  main = "Drug Use by Age + Education (Female)",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  labels_col = pretty_drug_labels(mat_female),
  color = female_colors
)

```
```{r}
# drug categories
legal_drugs <- c("Alcohol_Use", "Caffeine_Use", "Chocolate_Use", "Nicotine_Use")
illegal_drugs <- c("Cocaine_Use", "Heroin_Use", "LSD_Use", "Ketamine_Use")
all_drugs <- c(legal_drugs, illegal_drugs)



# reshape data to long format
data_long <- ddata %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(all_drugs),
    names_to = "Drug",
    values_to = "Use_Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Drug = str_remove(Drug, "_Use")  # remove "_Use" from drug names
  )



# reorder education
data_long$Education_Level_Final <- factor(
  data_long$Education_Level_Final,
  levels = c("Low education", "Medium education", "High education")
)


# Histogram by Gender
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Drug, fill = Use_Status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("User" = "#E9006D", "Non-User" = "#BCB8F0")  # custom colors
  ) +
  labs(title = "Drug Use by Gender",
       x = "Drug Type", y = "Number of Individuals", fill = "Use Status") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Histogram by Education
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Drug, fill = Use_Status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Education_Level_Final) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("User" = "#E9006D", "Non-User" = "#BCB8F0")  # custom colors
  ) +
  labs(title = "Drug Use by Education Level",
       x = "Drug Type", y = "Number of Individuals",
       fill = "Use Status") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Histogram by Age Group
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Drug, fill = Use_Status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Age_Group) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("User" = "#E9006D", "Non-User" = "#BCB8F0")  # custom colors
  ) +
  labs(title = "Drug Use by Age Group",
       x = "Drug Type", y = "Number of Individuals",  fill = "Use Status") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Example personality traits
personality_traits <- c("Neuroticism","Extraversion","Openness","Agreeableness")

ui <- dashboardPage(
  skin = "black",
  
 dashboardHeader(
  title = tags$div(
    style="background: linear-gradient(to right, #E9006D, #BCB8F0);
           padding: 5px 10px; 
           font-size: 16px;
           white-space: normal;
           line-height: 1.2;", 
    "Drug Use & Personality Dashboard"
  )
),
  
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("Overview", tabName = "overview", icon = icon("dashboard")),
      menuItem("Histogram", tabName = "hist", icon = icon("chart-bar")),
      menuItem("Boxplot", tabName = "box", icon = icon("box"))
    ),
    hr(),
    
    h4("Histogram Controls"),
    selectInput("facet_var", "Facet by:", choices = c("Gender","Education_Level_Final","Age_Group"), selected = "Gender"),
    checkboxGroupInput("drug_type_filter_hist", "Drug Type:", choices = c("Legal","Illegal"), selected = c("Legal","Illegal")),
    
    hr(),
    h4("Boxplot Controls"),
    selectInput("trait", "Personality Trait:", choices = personality_traits, selected = "Neuroticism"),
    checkboxGroupInput("drug_type_filter_box", "Drug Type:", choices = c("Legal","Illegal"), selected = c("Legal","Illegal"))
  ),
  
  dashboardBody(
    # Custom CSS
    tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
      /* Page background */
      .content-wrapper, .right-side {background-color: #f4f6f8;}
      /* Sidebar background */
      .main-sidebar {background-color: #2c3e50 !important;}
      /* Sidebar menu text */
      .sidebar-menu li a {color: #ecf0f1 !important; font-weight:bold;}
      /* Active menu item */
      .sidebar-menu li.active a {background-color: #E9006D !important; color: #fff !important;}
      /* Info boxes */
      .small-box {box-shadow: 2px 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);}
      /* Header gradient title */
      .main-header .logo {background: linear-gradient(to right, #E9006D, #BCB8F0) !important; color:#fff !important; font-weight:bold;}
    "))),
    
    tabItems(
      # Overview tab with value boxes
      tabItem(tabName = "overview",
              fluidRow(
                valueBoxOutput("total_users"),
                valueBoxOutput("total_nonusers"),
                valueBoxOutput("legal_vs_illegal")
              )
      ),
      
      # Histogram tab
      tabItem(tabName = "hist",
              fluidRow(
                box(title="Drug Use Histogram", width=12, status="primary", solidHeader=TRUE, plotlyOutput("hist_plot"))
              )
      ),
      
      # Boxplot tab
      tabItem(tabName = "box",
              fluidRow(
                box(title="Personality Traits Boxplot", width=12, status="primary", solidHeader=TRUE, plotlyOutput("box_plot"))
              )
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  
  # Example summary statistics
  output$total_users <- renderValueBox({
    valueBox(
      value = "1234", subtitle = "Total Users", icon = icon("users"), color = "red"
    )
  })
  output$total_nonusers <- renderValueBox({
    valueBox(
      value = "567", subtitle = "Total Non-Users", icon = icon("user-slash"), color = "blue"
    )
  })
  output$legal_vs_illegal <- renderValueBox({
    valueBox(
      value = "60% Legal", subtitle = "Drug Category", icon = icon("balance-scale"), color = "purple"
    )
  })
  
  # Histogram filter
  filtered_hist <- reactive({
    data_long_hist %>% filter(Drug_Type %in% input$drug_type_filter_hist)
  })
  
  output$hist_plot <- renderPlotly({
    p <- ggplot(filtered_hist(), aes(x = Drug, fill = Use_Status)) +
      geom_bar(position="dodge", color="black") +
      facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", input$facet_var))) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=c("User"="#E9006D","Non-User"="#BCB8F0")) +
      labs(x = "Drug Type", y = "Number of Individuals", fill = "Use Status") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
      theme(
        plot.background = element_rect(fill="#f4f6f8", color=NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill="#ffffff", color=NA),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill="#E9006D", color=NA),
        strip.text = element_text(color="#ffffff", face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)
      )
    ggplotly(p, tooltip=c("x","y","fill"))
  })
  
  # Boxplot filter
  filtered_box <- reactive({
    data_long_box %>% filter(Category %in% input$drug_type_filter_box)
  })
  
  output$box_plot <- renderPlotly({
    y_var <- sym(input$trait)
    p <- ggplot(filtered_box(), aes(x=Usage, y=!!y_var, fill=Usage)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      facet_wrap(~Category) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=c("User"="#E9006D","Non-User"="#BCB8F0")) +
      labs(x="", y=paste(input$trait,"Score"), fill="Usage") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
      theme(
        plot.background = element_rect(fill="#f4f6f8", color=NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill="#ffffff", color=NA),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill="#E9006D", color=NA),
        strip.text = element_text(color="#ffffff", face="bold")
      )
    ggplotly(p, tooltip=c("x","y","fill"))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

```
